title: Design a Movie Ticket Booking System
summary: Stop two people buying the same seat by holding it under an expiring lock taken before payment and released after, with a builder assembling the booking, a repository hiding where shows live, and a caching proxy in front of it.
concepts: Expiring seat locks as the answer to a double-booking race
Why payment must happen inside the lock, not before or after
All-or-nothing seat claims so a party is never split
Availability belongs to the show, not the seat
Proxy that caches reads and invalidates on write
Builder for an object assembled across several steps
extensions: Move seat locks to Redis so the guarantee holds across processes
Add group booking with adjacent-seat allocation
Add coupons and loyalty points to the pricing chain
Add refunds with a time-based cancellation policy
Add waitlists that notify when a booking is cancelled
Handle a payment gateway timeout where the outcome is unknown
